array.string: exec >>"$HOME/Library/Logs/i9-claude-sync.log" 2>&1; date; ssh_command="ssh -p 2222 -l w -i $HOME/.ssh/i9-claude-sync -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o IdentityAgent=none -o BatchMode=yes -o HostKeyAlias=i9 -o ConnectTimeout=10 -o ServerAliveInterval=15 -o ServerAliveCountMax=4"; for pause in 60 300 0; do /opt/homebrew/bin/rsync -a --timeout=300 -e "$ssh_command" i9: "$HOME/.claude/projects/" && exit 0; sleep "$pause"; done; osascript -e 'display notification "See ~/Library/Logs/i9-claude-sync.log, then run launchctl kickstart gui/$(id -u)/io.github.neuramance.i9-claude-sync." with title "i9 Claude Code sync failed"'; exit 1
